This era of the MSI Titan GT80s is what happens when a company lets their engineers cook. Brute forcing your way to more FPS using 2 GPU's in SLI configuration was an insane engineering feat that STILL deserves credit for just how ballsy it was. 
But I'm afraid taking risks like this is going to be a thing of the past. Companies just can't afford to take risks like they used to. 
The early to mid 2000 was peak technology, even though I couldn't afford any of it. It was when enthusiasts could design computers for enthusiasts, and the average consumer still had access to decent computers at an affordable price.
But if AI continues to kill the PC industry, computers will just become a subscription, and all of these engineering marvels will be replaced by a MacBook Neo.

author: Salem Techsperts
description: This $4,500 monster from 2015 has TWO NVIDIA GTX 980m GPUs in SLI, and it just lost to a Steam Deck. 🤯 The Mid 2000's Dual GPU SLI Era had some INSANE Gaming Laptops that pushed the limits of engineering. Thankfully I can finally afford to buy them used and refurbish them to see how they've held up over the years.
